sentences: Multiclass learning allows labels beyond a binary choice, and its general learning rules are less well understood than ordinary binary empirical risk minimization.
This project asks whether every learnable multiclass class can be learned using local regularization.
The regularizer may depend on the test point, allowing the resulting predictor to combine behavior from different hypotheses across the domain.
The source also asks for optimal sample complexity and proposes a particular learnable class as a possible counterexample.
A resolution would either supply a general algorithmic template for multiclass learning or identify a task requiring more global information about the sample.
